entries.german:
Lehengegenbrief des Leonhart von Rosenberg zu Uttenhofen über 4 Höfe u. 2 Sölden zu Oberried bei Uttenhofen in der Seglau bei der Schwarzach im Landgericht Hirsperg.
Lehenherr: Herzog Wilhelm IV.
entries.english:
Feudal counter-document by Leonhard von Rosenberg of Uttenhofen concerning 4 farms and 2 homesteads in Oberried near Uttenhofen in the Seglau near the Schwarzach in the district of Hirschberg.
Feudal lord: Duke Wilhelm IV.

facts.content: issued a fief counterletter to Herzog Wilhelm IV concerning four farms and two smallholdings at Oberried near Uttenhofen.
